what_it_does: Reduces memory and computation demands of large language model inference on long text sequences by combining two pruning strategies in specialized hardware. The system uses a hybrid architecture with both content-addressable memory (fast lookup by pattern matching) and computation-in-memory (performing math operations directly where data is stored) modes. Static pruning removes attention values using predetermined patterns, while dynamic pruning identifies and discards low-importance key-value pairs at runtime, achieving flexible pruning tailored to actual input difficulty.
